Module io.github.brantunger.unruly.core

Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.exception

@NullMarked package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.exception
The exceptions the engine throws, all unchecked and all extending UnrulyException.
  • RulesEngine.load(java.util.List) throws RuleCompilationException, whose failures() lists each problem it found.
  • RulesEngine.run(io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.FactStore) throws RuleExecutionException, for a failure inside a rule or one that belongs to no rule, such as a stopped run.
  • An expression language's compiler throws InvalidExpressionException to reject an expression; load() reports it as the cause of a RuleCompilationException that names the rule.
  • Misuse throws IllegalStateException (running before load(), or on a closed engine) or IllegalArgumentException (a fact name rules can't use, or a fact that doesn't match its declaration). A run also throws IllegalStateException when the engine's rule list was closed over and over while it was borrowing a copy of it, which means an engine invariant has broken rather than that the call was wrong.

On either engine exception, getRuleName() names the failing rule, or is null for a failure that isn't about one rule; getExpressionKind() says whether its condition or its action failed; and issues() on a RuleCompilationException says where the language found each problem.

Types in this package are non-null unless annotated Nullable.
